description: The SQLite invoice exercise has a verified benefit beyond the live free download. On five fictional cases, the plain join overcounted a multiply tagged invoice, SUM(DISTINCT amount) undercounted equal-value invoices, and EXISTS passed all five cases. That supports a concrete buyer preview. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, but five sources are unclassified and the interpretations cannot establish buyer attribution or demand. Gumroad activation depends on verified product and Canadian seller eligibility. The same exercise can support an eligible training inquiry through a separate authorized route.
